class Traces {

  static String typed(int n) {
    try {
      if (n > 0) {
          throw "boom";
      }

      return "none";
    } catch (String e) {
      String s = "";
      return "typed:" + e + ":[" + s + "]";
    }
  }

  static String bare(int n) {
    try {
      if (n > 0) {
          throw "bang";
      }

      return "none";
    } catch (Exception e) {
      String s = "";
      return "bare:" + e + ":[" + s + "]";
    }
  }

}

class Traces {

  fun typed(n: Int): String {
    try {
      if (n > 0) {
          throw "boom";
      }

      return "none"
    } catch (e: String) {
      var s = ""
      return "typed:$e:[$s]"
    }
  }

  fun bare(n: Int): String {
    try {
      if (n > 0) {
          throw "bang";
      }

      return "none"
    } catch (e: Throwable) {
      var s = ""
      return "bare:$e:[$s]"
    }
  }

}
